scripts.build: npm run check:i18n && tsc && vite build
scripts.e2e:prepare: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const { execSync } = require('node:child_process'); const { chromium } = require('@playwright/test'); let executable = ''; try { executable = chromium.executablePath(); } catch (error) {} if (!executable || !fs.existsSync(executable)) { execSync('npx playwright install chromium', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
scripts.e2e:ai: npm run e2e:prepare && node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const env = { ...process.env, RUN_AI_VISION_E2E: '1' }; const result = spawnSync('npx', ['playwright', 'test', 'e2e/ai_onboarding.spec.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit', env, shell: true }); if (result.error) console.error(result.error); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
